purpose: Crawls content for training generative AI foundation models
blocking_costs: Training corpus inclusion only. Blocking does not remove a site from ChatGPT search answers.

purpose: Surfaces websites in ChatGPT search features
blocking_costs: ChatGPT search answers. A site opted out of OAI-SearchBot is not shown in them.

purpose: Fetches a page when a ChatGPT user or a custom GPT action asks for it
blocking_costs: Live user-initiated retrieval. OpenAI states robots.txt rules may not apply because the action is user-initiated, so a robots.txt entry is not a reliable control here.

purpose: Validates the safety of pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
blocking_costs: Ad submission review only. Data is not used for model training.

purpose: Collects web content to improve the utility and safety of Anthropic models
blocking_costs: Training corpus inclusion. Blocking this alone does not remove Claude search citations, which run through Claude-SearchBot.

purpose: Navigates the web to improve search result quality for Claude users
blocking_costs: Claude search citations. This is the token that decides whether Claude can cite the site in search.

purpose: Supports user-initiated web access when a Claude user asks for a page
blocking_costs: Live user-initiated retrieval. Anthropic documents that this fetcher honours robots.txt, unlike the equivalent fetchers at OpenAI and Perplexity.

purpose: Legacy Anthropic robots.txt token kept in circulation by older configurations
blocking_costs: Nothing current. Superseded by the three named Anthropic tokens.

purpose: Surfaces and links websites in Perplexity search results
blocking_costs: Perplexity search results and their citations.

purpose: Visits a page when a Perplexity user asks a question that needs it
blocking_costs: Live user-initiated retrieval. Perplexity documents that this fetcher generally ignores robots.txt, so a robots.txt entry does not control it.

purpose: Crawls for Google Search and is the source that feeds AI Overviews
blocking_costs: Google Search itself, and with it AI Overviews. There is no separate opt-out for AI Overviews.

purpose: Not a crawler. Google documents that it has no separate HTTP user-agent string and that crawling is done with existing Google agents, the token being used in a control capacity only
blocking_costs: Gemini training and grounding in AI applications. Google states it does not affect inclusion in Google Search nor act as a ranking signal, and it does not change crawl rate.

purpose: Generic crawler used by Google product teams for one-off crawls and internal research
blocking_costs: Nothing product-specific. Google states preferences addressed to this token do not affect any given product.

purpose: Crawls for Siri and Spotlight Suggestions
blocking_costs: Apple search surfaces.

purpose: Control token governing whether crawled content trains Apple foundation models
blocking_costs: Apple model training only. It does not affect Applebot crawling for search.

purpose: Crawls to improve Alexa answers and Amazon AI features
blocking_costs: Alexa answers and Amazon AI surfaces.

purpose: Crawls content for training and improving Meta AI products
blocking_costs: Meta AI training corpus.

purpose: Crawls for Meta speech and language model improvement
blocking_costs: Meta model improvement corpora.

purpose: Crawls content for ByteDance model training
blocking_costs: Training corpus inclusion. Compliance with robots.txt has been publicly disputed, so treat a robots.txt entry as a request rather than a control.

purpose: Builds the Common Crawl open corpus that many models train on downstream
blocking_costs: Common Crawl inclusion, and indirectly any model trained on it. No live search surface depends on it.

purpose: Crawls content for Cohere model training
blocking_costs: Cohere training corpus.

purpose: Crawls to surface results in You.com search and answers
blocking_costs: You.com results.
